evidence.quote: Keep fees separate, subject to court approval, and direct any unawarded amount to the class.
We propose a $32 million class fund, distributed automatically to identified members, plus $2 million in fees and expenses subject to court approval.

summary: Plaintiff raised attorneys’ fees first and included a fee term in the initial proposal before the class fund was settled. The transcript does not clearly show any tradeoff between fees and class relief, plaintiff self-dealing, defense leveraging fee interests, reverse-auction tactics, or a misleading declaration.
